title: Closing Fee Schedule: Origination Fee on Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
An origination fee is charged at closing on every Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage. Three figures fix it for each product: the **origination fee percentage** (the fee at closing, as a percentage of original principal), the **minimum origination fee** in USD and the **maximum origination fee** in USD.

| Product | Origination fee (% of original principal) | Minimum fee (USD) | Maximum fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 0.5 | 500 | 7500 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 0.5 | 500 | 7500 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 0.5 | 500 | 7500 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 0.5 | 750 | 10000 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.75 | 750 | 10000 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 0.75 | 1000 | 12500 |

**Where the bounds bite (derived from the table).** The percentage reaches the maximum at an original principal of USD 1500000 on the Variable-Rate, 3-Year and 5-Year products (0.5 percent of 1500000 is 7500), at USD 2000000 on the 10-Year Adjustable (0.5 percent of 2000000 is 10000), at about USD 1333333.33 on the 15-Year Fixed (0.75 percent is 10000) and at about USD 1666666.67 on the 25-Year Fixed (0.75 percent is 12500). Below USD 100000 on the Variable-Rate product, 0.5 percent is less than USD 500 and the minimum applies.

**Hypothetical examples.** A USD 80000 loan on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage: 0.5 percent is USD 400.00, below the minimum, so the fee is USD 500.00. A USD 2400000 loan on the FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage: 0.75 percent is USD 18000.00, above the maximum, so the fee is USD 10000.00. A USD 600000 loan on the FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage: 0.5 percent is USD 3000.00, within both bounds.
